question: Why is sound considered sweet and linked to supreme vital power?
premises: Sound is sweet because it increases vital power.
That vital power is supreme and pure.
That vital power is regarded as having the nature of a desire to emit.
inference: Sweet sound nourishes the supreme pure vital power whose essence is the impulse to emanate.
plain_english: Sound too is sweet because it increases vital power. That vital power is supreme and pure, and it is understood to have the nature of a desire to emit.
